verdict.rationale: Vercel's own Postgres product has been discontinued. Vercel does document provisioning a Postgres database through its Marketplace from providers such as Neon, Supabase, Prisma Postgres and AWS Aurora Postgres, with credentials injected into the project, so managed Postgres is delivered through third-party integrations rather than a first-party service. missing for 10: any evidence of point-in-time recovery, read replicas, or high availability, a first-party managed Postgres offering, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can provision a fully-managed Postgres database with point-in-time recovery, replicas, and high availability

citations.quote: Provision and configure a Postgres database with minimal setup. Have credentials and environment variables injected into your Vercel project.
Select from a range of Postgres providers, including Neon, Prisma Postgres, Supabase, and AWS Aurora Postgres.
